ayuda_texto: Look up a preparation by its reference. For a specific revision, enter its number and fingerprint. You can open a local preparer output and download its original. Lookup responses cannot be downloaded. None of these actions approve, sign or publish the rules.
archivo_pista: Select the preparer JSON output, rather than its input file. Maximum 4 MiB; up to 1,024 items per list.
limite: Local review of synthetic material. The file does not establish a call for applications, signature, approval or publication.
vacio: Look up a preparation or open a preparer output file.
cargado: File opened: {archivo}. Review the outstanding checks before continuing.
descarga_lista: Download prepared with the original content, unchanged.
error_tamano: Cannot open the file: it is empty or exceeds 4 MiB. Select a smaller preparer output.
error_formato: Cannot open the file: it does not match the preparer output. Generate the JSON output again and select it.
error_catalogo: The screen text could not be loaded. Reload before opening a file.
plazos_limite: Dates come from the proposed material. They do not establish a legal deadline. Madrid time.
documentos_limite: Paths are proposals. This viewer does not open or download these documents.
referencias_limite: References are not consulted. Their source, existence and validity remain unverified.
ver_detalle_archivo: View all material and local review data
sin_elementos: No items have been supplied for this section.

motivos.referencia_ausente: The exact reference, version and content hash are missing.
motivos.referencia_invalida: The supplied reference does not pass Bolsa's format check.
motivos.referencia_no_verificada: The reference has a valid format; its source, existence and validity remain unverified.
motivos.material_ausente: This item is missing from the proposal.
motivos.contenido_no_validado: The proposed content does not pass Bolsa's complete validation. It is retained for completion or correction.
motivos.circuito_pendiente: The authorised procedure and its evidence are pending. The proposed material does not establish completion of this step.

consulta_limite: Internal lookup with your session permissions. Approval, signature and publication remain pending.
consulta_pista: Use the reference received when preparing the rules. A specific revision requires its original number and fingerprint.

consulta_validacion.referencia: Enter a valid reference without spaces, up to 180 characters.
consulta_validacion.revision: Enter a revision number from 1 to 1,000,000.

consulta_lista: Enter the preparation and select Look up preparation.
consulta_obtenida: Preparation retrieved. Review the outstanding checks; the rules are not approved.
consulta_cancelada: Lookup cancelled. You can look up another preparation.
origen_consulta: Retained preparation material. The original receipt and this lookup access are separate evidence.

consulta_errores.selector_invalido: Cannot look up these details. Check the reference and, for a specific revision, its number and fingerprint.
consulta_errores.respuesta_incompatible: Cannot display the received response. Try again; if this persists, contact IT.
consulta_errores.acceso_denegado: Your current session cannot access this preparation. Check access with the service manager.
consulta_errores.no_encontrada: This preparation was not found. Check the reference and requested revision.
consulta_errores.version_en_conflicto: The requested revision does not match the retained revision. Check its original number and fingerprint.
consulta_errores.servicio_no_disponible: Could not retrieve the preparation. Try again; if this persists, contact IT.
consulta_errores.operacion_abortada: Lookup cancelled. You can look up another preparation.

ver_detalle_consulta: View revision, receipts and full response
